verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia (part of the Kong product family) supports writing and running API tests, importing tests from Postman, chaining requests to extract response data, and automating test runs via Inso CLI in CI, which implies assertion-style testing capability. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms that assertions can be written against response status, body, and headers specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of status-code/body/header assertion syntax, and independent/hands-on confirmation that such assertions work in practice.
